five_scaled_mad_policy_caveat: The 5-scaled-MAD policy was set after exploratory inspection; retain this caveat in the case.

calibration_crosscheck.selection_rule: Before inspecting agreement: include the usable shortest- and longest-wavelength observations, plus the earliest UTC usable observation for each detector. Deduplicate only identical observation_id+detector pairs.
measurements_to_record: MEF WCS-WAVE at the mapped detector pixel
standalone S3 CWAVE and CBAND at the mapped detector pixel
EPSF CWAVESRC and CBANDSRC when present
IRSA response metadata and product provenance
calibration_crosscheck.version_match_rule: Confirmed only when the calibration map HISTORY source filename matches the cutout WCS-WAVE HISTORY source filename and detector matches; separately record the S3 product key/version and any IRSA response version metadata. Missing or conflicting metadata is unverified/mismatch, not assumed.

injection_test_plan.frames: All 61 usable observations in the frozen control-star bundle; one trial per level per observation.

position_shift_arcsec.direction: east in the ICRS tangent plane

injection_test_plan.injection_method: Operate on per-trial copies of cached real cutout FITS. Use that frame EPSF array as the normalized PSF; preserve real background, flags, and variance arrays. For flux-change trials, add the specified fraction of the measured control-star aperture flux through the PSF, normalized to unit flux inside the same 3-pixel aperture. For position trials, subtract the PSF model fit to the measured source and add it at the specified eastward-shifted position. Do not alter the source case or the frozen bundle.
injection_test_plan.detection_criterion: Use the unchanged source-extraction gates: local peak SNR >= 5, centroid associated within 5 pixels of the simulated predicted position, and frame passes the frozen quality/edge policy. Count a trial as recovered only if these gates pass and the relevant aperture flux or centroid is finite. This measures algorithmic source/measurement recovery, not statistical variability or motion significance.
injection_test_plan.systematics_limit: Injection into real cutouts preserves some background/noise/flags but not the unknown cross-frame calibration and resampling systematics; it cannot establish real-world variability or motion sensitivity.
